blocks.text: Nervous system mein kuch khaas cells neurons ki madad (support) karte hain. In madadgar cells ko neuroglia ya glial cells kehte hain. Yeh neurons ko ghiza (nutrients) dete hain, fuzla (wastes) hatate hain aur immunity (bimari se hifazat) dete hain. Do aham glial cells Schwann cells aur oligodendrocytes hain. Yeh bohat se neurons ke axons ke gird lipte hote hain aur axons par myelin sheaths (membrane ki kai tahon wale ghilaf) banate hain. Schwann cells peripheral nervous system ke axons par myelin sheath banate hain. Oligodendrocytes central nervous system mein myelin sheath banate hain.

Myelin sheath ek insulating (bijli ko rokne wala) ghilaf hai. Yeh axon par nerve impulse ko tezi se chalne mein madad deta hai. Jin neurons ke axons par myelin sheath ho unhein myelinated, aur jin par yeh ghilaf na ho unhein non-myelinated kehte hain. CNS mein myelinated axons white matter banate hain, aur non-myelinated dendrites aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain. Peripheral nervous system mein myelinated aur non-myelinated dono axons ikatthe bandh kar nerves banate hain. Myelinated neurons mein myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm ke baad chhoti khaali jagahon (non-myelinated hisson) se toot'ti hai. In khaali jagahon ko nodes of Ranvier kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Dimagh mein myelin kaun se cells banate hain, aur baazu ki nerve mein kaun se?
blocks.explanation: Dimagh (CNS) mein oligodendrocytes; baazu ki nerve (PNS) mein Schwann cells.

items: Neuron ke teen hisse: cell body (nucleus, Nissl's granules), dendrites (paigham cell body ki taraf) aur axon (paigham cell body se door, axon terminal tak).

Neuroglia neurons ki madad karte hain; Schwann cells (PNS) aur oligodendrocytes (CNS) myelin sheath banate hain; har 1 se 2 mm par nodes of Ranvier; CNS mein myelinated axons white matter aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain.
